game.title: Red Dead Redemption
game.blurb: Open-world Western action-adventure in which John Marston hunts down outlaws at the start of the twentieth century, from Rockstar San Diego and Rockstar Games (PC port with Double Eleven), released 2010-05-18. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story

StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Red_Dead_Redemption
Fandom (reddead.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://reddead.fandom.com/wiki/Red_Dead_Redemption
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). A PC release exists on Steam: app 2668510, listed as "Red Dead Redemption"; its schema calls the app "Kalon" (an internal codename). Its achievement list includes Undead Nightmare entries. RAWG's entry is the original 2010 game (id 4544); RAWG has separate entries for Undead Nightmare and the Game of the Year Edition. StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 1, but the walkthrough is barely written: of about 20 mission and character subpages it links, only "Walkthrough" (about 2,400 characters) and "Bonnie" (about 5,500) exist, plus Achievements and trophies (about 9,900), Weapons, Multiplayer, Ranks, Controls, Mounts, Gameplay and Table of Contents. Its contents page also links "Undead Nightmare Pack", "Liars and Cheats Pack", "Legends and Killers Pack" and "Outlaws to the End Co-Op Mission Pack", none of them written. That is too little for a real guide, so it was not recorded in sw-structure.json and swUsed is off. reddead.fandom.com answers the API, with about 237 linked pages, including "Undead Nightmare", "Strangers", "Gang Hideouts" and "Legendary Animals"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 20 of 51 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions. The eight hidden ones at the top of the list are treated as story beats. Achievements 42 to 51 sit around the two achievements that name Undead Nightmare (47 and 48), so the eight hidden ones there were put in the Undead Nightmare chapter by list position only; this needs checking, especially "Six Years In The Making". Four other hidden ones ("Dastardly", "Manifest Destiny", "Spurred to Victory", "Heading South on a White Bronco") sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder; they are listed away from the story block and may be side content. RAWG lists a playtime of only 6 hours, which looks low.
